Eat it to recover a bit of health.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Zapshrooms are a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make Toasty Zapshrooms by burning [[Zapshroom]]s with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} A completely roasted Toasty Zapshroom is considered to be delicious. When eaten, they restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Zapshrooms return in {{TotK}} as a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They are made when [[Zapshroom]]s come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Toasty Zapshrooms are thought by many to be delicious. They can restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] if they are eaten. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Zapshroom }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
